name: Smart Bulk Content Remover
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Smart Bulk Content Remover gives you an easy way to clean up and maintain your WordPress site by removing unwanted content in bulk. Whether you need to delete outdated posts, old pages, unused media, or spam comments, this plugin provides a safe and streamlined interface.

Key features include:

  • Bulk delete posts, pages, custom post types, media files, and comments.
  • Filter by post type, status, author and date range before deletion.
  • Choose between moving items to the trash or permanent deletion.
  • Responsive, user-friendly interface integrated into the WordPress admin area.
  • Works with WordPress core post types and any public custom post types.

This plugin is ideal for site owners, bloggers, editors, and administrators who need to quickly clean up large amounts of content without manually deleting one by one.

Features

  • Flexible Filters: Search and filter by title/content, status (published, draft, pending, spam, trash), author, and date range.
  • Safe Deletion: Option to move content to the trash or permanently delete with one click.
  • Multi-Content Support: Works with posts, pages, custom post types, media library items, and comments.
  • Bulk Actions: Select multiple items and delete them simultaneously.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Minimal overhead with a focus on performance.

Credits

Developed by solankisoftware.
Donations are welcome at PayPal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-bulk-content-remover directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools → Smart Bulk Content Remover (or the plugin’s menu) to access the interface.
  4. Use the filters to select which content you want to remove and click the delete button.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin permanently delete content?

By default, items are moved to the Trash. You can check the “Permanently delete” option to skip the Trash and remove content immediately.

Will it work with custom post types?

Yes. It automatically detects and lists all public custom post types registered on your site.

Is there an undo option?

If you move content to the Trash, you can restore it from the WordPress Trash screen. Permanent deletion cannot be undone.
